title: server.rs: user_id = 1 hardcoded across multiple route arms
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/mail/src/server.rs, route_method has let user_id: i64 = 1; scattered as a TODO across multiple match arms. This is a multi-occurrence dead constant that signals incomplete multi-user support. The comment appears in several arms rather than being extracted once.

What needs to be done: Extract user_id resolution into a single function called once before the match, so when real user resolution is implemented there is one place to change.
